help:
Hi! I'm an AI assistant. Just send me a message and I'll do my best to help. I can search the web and read web pages when needed, and I can read pictures, PDF files and text files you send me.

Commands:
/help - show this message
/reset - forget this conversation (and delete its files) and start fresh
/compact - summarise older messages to free up memory
trigger_task_failed: Sorry, I could not carry out the scheduled task "%s" just now.
reset_done: Done. This conversation has been cleared.
compact_done: Done. Older messages have been summarised.
compact_nothing: The conversation is still short; there is nothing to compact yet.
busy: I'm still working on your previous messages. Please wait a moment and try again.
rate_limited: You're sending messages too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_generic: Sorry, something went wrong while processing your message. Please try again.
empty_response: Sorry, I couldn't come up with a reply. Could you rephrase your message?
unsupported_attachment: Sorry, I can only read pictures, PDF files and text files.
not_allowed: Sorry, you are not allowed to use this bot.
web_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
web_rate_limited: You are going too fast. Please wait a moment.
web_code_prompt: Enter the access code to start chatting.
attach_err_too_large: the file is too large (the limit is %s)
attach_err_unsupported: that kind of file isn't supported (I can read pictures, PDF files and text files)
attach_err_pages: the document has too many pages (the limit is %d)
attach_err_vision: this assistant can't look at pictures
attach_err_scanned: this PDF is a scan and text recognition isn't available
attach_err_generic: something went wrong while reading it
attach_rate_limited: You're sending files too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
attach_too_many: I can read at most %d files per message; the others were ignored.
attach_err_not_text: that file looks like binary data or uses a text encoding I can't read (save it as UTF-8)
